# `/form-instances` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /form-instances/v1

`searchFormInstancesByTenantV1` — List form instances by tenant.

Returns a list of form instances for the tenant. Optionally filter by form definition ID.

- Scopes: sp:forms:manage, sp:forms:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Limit Integer specifying the maximum number of records to return in a single API call. The standard syntax described in [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: formDefinitionId: eq — e.g. `formDefinitionId eq "351c1daa-56f6-4bbf-b32c-49844c0b716e"`
- Returns 200: array of listforminstancesbytenantresponse

### POST /form-instances/v1

`createFormInstanceV1` — Creates a form instance.



- Scopes: sp:forms:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): createforminstancerequest
- Returns 201: forminstanceresponse

### GET /form-instances/v1/{formInstanceID}

`getFormInstanceByKeyV1` — Returns a form instance.

Parameter `{formInstanceID}` should match a form instance ID. Only the assigned recipient (`recipients[].id` when `type` is `IDENTITY`) may call this.

- User levels: USER
- Parameters:
  - `formInstanceID` (path, required) — Form instance ID
- Returns 200: forminstanceresponse

### PATCH /form-instances/v1/{formInstanceID}

`patchFormInstanceV1` — Patch a form instance.

Parameter `{formInstanceID}` should match a form instance ID. Only the assigned recipient (`recipients[].id` when `type` is `IDENTITY`) may call this.

- User levels: USER
- Parameters:
  - `formInstanceID` (path, required) — Form instance ID
- Body (application/json): array of operation-2
- Returns 200: forminstanceresponse

### GET /form-instances/v1/{formInstanceID}/data-source/{formElementID}

`searchFormElementDataByElementIDV1` — Retrieves dynamic data by element.

Parameter `{formInstanceID}` should match a form instance ID. Parameter `{formElementID}` should match a form element ID at the data source configuration.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `formInstanceID` (path, required) — Form instance ID
  - `formElementID` (path, required) — Form element ID
  - `limit` (query) — default 250 — Limit Integer specifying the maximum number of records to return in a single API call. The standard syntax described in [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: value: eq, ne, in — e.g. `value eq "ID01"`
  - `query` (query) — String that is passed to the underlying API to filter other (non-ID) fields. For example, for access profile data sources, this string will be passed to the access profile api and used with a…
- Returns 200: listformelementdatabyelementidresponse

### GET /form-instances/v1/{formInstanceID}/file/{fileID}

`getFormInstanceFileV1` — Download instance file by fileid.



- Scopes: sp:forms:manage
- Parameters:
  - `formInstanceID` (path, required) — FormInstanceID Form instance ID
  - `fileID` (path, required) — FileID String specifying the hashed name of the uploaded file we are retrieving.
- Returns 200: string
